headline: PF's -50.00% collapse on 16.83x volume follows SET's caution on GRAND, PF and ROH, and broad selling hit PROP and CONS names across the coverage.
market_take: Risk tone is clearly defensive, with sharp declines concentrated in PROP and CONS while PF and XBIO each fell 50.00% and 25.00% on the day. Many of the largest one-day drops carry unusual-trading alerts, and several connect directly to fresh SET clarification announcements. Filing flow also shows elevated event risk, including auditor disclaimers at NRF and a contract-termination clarification at PLE.

sector_notes.note: PF fell 50.00% to 0.02 on 16.83x volume after SET recommended investors study information on GRAND, PF and ROH. JCK declined 11.76% with a -5.88% open gap, while ORI fell 5.84% on 5.68x volume.
MIPF gained 6.17% on 0.16x volume and TU-PF fell 4.81% on 3.23x volume. ALLY, CPNREIT and AMATAR each registered volume-spike alerts, and TTLPF filed Q3 2026 MD&A.

Selling was broad: TPOLY -11.11%, STECON -7.53%, RT -7.14%, STPI -6.20% and SQ -5.88%. TRITN rose 50.00% over five days despite a -33.33% open-gap alert, while PLE disclosed both a contract-termination clarification and revised Q3 results.
XBIO dropped 25.00% to 0.03 on minimal 0.01x volume, and PLUS fell 7.78%. NRF carries an auditor disclaimer on its financial statements alongside SP postings on NRF and TTCL.
SCGD filed a share-repurchase report for financial management purposes, while PPP disclosed a director resignation. Neither name appears in the top movers.
SMO disclosed the appointment of directors and changes to board committee composition. No AGRI name appears in the top movers.
